mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signal an accommodative monetary policy environment that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 9.5% indicate a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 700 thousand units and retail sales below 350 billion dollars indicate a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST < 700 and RSAFS < 350000.

mechanism_narrative: During the early recovery phase (INDPRO < 105), weak industrial production signals ongoing economic fragility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index below 220 indicates low inflation, which is associated with a favorable environment for equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 220.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals the beginning of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls above 130,000 thousand and a decline in unemployment rate below 9.5% indicates a strengthening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 and UNRATE < 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST > 700), rising housing starts signal increased consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 700.
